FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creative Canvas Studio, we operate a vibrant and welcoming space dedicated to artistic creation and community engagement. Our primary focus is on non-hazardous artistic activities, including painting, drawing, and textile crafts, ensuring that all materials used are non-toxic and water-based whenever possible. We prioritize safety by adhering to all local zoning and health regulations, and maintain comprehensive fire detection and suppression systems. Our studio features secure storage for valuable artwork and tools, reinforced by robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer information during online sales. 

Additionally, we offer public workshops that are designed with established safety protocols and participant waivers in place to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone. We also conduct regular safety training and maintain proper ventilation to further enhance the safety of our working environment. Our commitment to using only safe materials, combined with a focus on community creativity and education, makes Creative Canvas Studio a responsible and inspiring place for art lovers of all ages.

Our studio specializes in various artistic techniques, including glassblowing and large-scale woodworking, which are integral to our creative process and the unique pieces we produce.
